title: Machine Learning
summary: The managed AI services you call through an API without ML expertise: Rekognition for images and video, Transcribe and Polly for speech, Translate, Comprehend and Comprehend Medical for text, Lex and Amazon Connect for conversations, Textract for documents, Kendra for search and Personalize for recommendations. Then SageMaker AI for custom models, how to map scenario keywords to the right service, and the 2025-2026 retirements and renames.
